news.title: STRAiNGER · Tilt Guild · Kawaii Sharx — Live @ NAOS
news.description: Tilt Guild are set to perform live at NAOS in Athens alongside STRAiNGER and Kawaii Sharx on April 25, 2026.

news.title: 'To Kolpo (Live)' — New Live Album Out Now
news.description: Tilt Guild have released 'To Kolpo (Live)', an 8-track live album, now available on Spotify.

news.title: Debut Album 'Το Κόλπο' Released November 2024
news.description: Tilt Guild, a DIY independent rap metal band formed in Athens, Greece, released their debut album 'Το Κόλπο' (To Kolpo / 'The Trick') on November 22, 2024, drawing inspiration from bands like Body Count, Rage Against The Machine, and Limp Bizkit.
